original_data.status: Hypothetical simulation, not empirical market data
original_data.simulation: IID Gaussian draws; fixed parameters; no volatility clustering or regime changes. No generated return is below -1, but Gaussian simple-return models do not guarantee this for arbitrary draws.

conventions: Covariance PCA uses ddof=1; explained variance is distinct from portfolio variance contributions.
Inverse HHI and entropy effective counts are reported separately with formulas and factor-basis dependence.
PCA scores are uncorrelated in the training sample; independence requires stronger assumptions.
Correlation distance sqrt((1-rho)/2) equals Euclidean distance between standardized histories divided by 2*sqrt(T-1).
Exact three-medoid selection enumerates all 20 subsets and breaks objective ties within 1e-12 by lexicographic order.
Affinity Propagation preference is a modeling choice; cluster labels have no ordering semantics; exemplar ties may vary numerically.
Network standardization uses ddof=0 to match empirical covariance normalization.
Graph alpha is selected on four chronological folds with fold-specific mean and SD; final 52 weeks excluded.
Precision zero means Gaussian conditional independence only under the model; estimated zeros are not population proofs or causal effects.
Overlapping-window edge frequencies are sensitivity diagnostics, not truth probabilities or a replication of formal stability selection.
Classical metric MDS projects a Gram matrix to two dimensions; relative distance error is explicitly defined, not mislabeled as sklearn stress.
Portfolio comparisons use weekly target-weight rebalancing, no fees, initial wealth 1 before week 209 and no forced terminal liquidation. One simulated path establishes no universal method ranking.

For teaching reproducibility, AP memberships are followed by an explicit within-cluster exemplar refinement on unperturbed similarity. Select the highest total similarity; candidates within 1e-12 tie and the lowest asset index wins. Common scalar preferences do not change the within-cluster argmax. Portfolio weights use these refined representatives, not the raw library exemplar index. No holdout return enters the rule.
K-means nearest-member ties within 1e-12 use the lowest member index. MDS display axes orient the largest absolute loading positively; distances and statistical calculations are unchanged.
